data.summary: Results-driven Technical Program Manager with 18+ years of experience delivering large-scale IT, Data, AI/ML, Cloud, and enterprise application development programs across global and public-sector environments. Strong foundation in application development and system integration, combined with extensive leadership in digital transformation, cloud modernization, and data platform initiatives. Proven expertise in Agile, SAFe, and hybrid delivery models, leading complex multi-stream programs and cross- functional teams in fast-paced, regulated environments. Experienced in technical program governance, architecture reviews, stakeholder alignment, vendor-led deployments, and executing large-scale transitions and migration programs. Adept at bridging business strategy with scalable, secure technology solutions—driving innovation, operational efficiency, and measurable business outcomes through structured program execution and modern cloud-based architectures.

domain_and_functional: Program, Project & Portfolio Governance and Delivery Management
all_skills: Program, Project & Portfolio Governance and Delivery Management

experience.role: Associate General Manager (Sr. Technical Program Manager)
responsibilities: Lead enterprise-scale Data, AI, and Digital Transformation programs across public-sector and regulated environments.
Govern Open Source FIWARE and Azure-based Data Platform Modernization and AI/ML initiatives including architecture validation, roadmap alignment, and operational readiness.
Manage cross-functional delivery teams (80–100 members) across engineering, data, cloud, and business units.
Drive vendor-led deployments, multi-partner coordination, and hybrid delivery execution.
Deliver structured program governance including risk management, executive reporting, SLA/KPI tracking, and compliance alignment.
Generated $1.5M+ in approved business value through strategic proposals and transformation initiatives.
Managed enterprise programs with annual budget ownership of up to $5M across multi-vendor, cross-functional delivery environments.
Directed large-scale digital modernization and enterprise application programs across Enterprise, BFSI, Public Sector and global clients.
Led transition and migration programs including cloud adoption and system integration initiatives.
Managed multi-geography delivery teams and fixed-price, T&M, and managed services engagements.
Achieved 12% cost savings on $6M procurement through strategic negotiation and delivery optimization.
Improved delivery efficiency by 35% through process re-engineering and automation initiatives.
Delivered enterprise IT and application transformation programs for Global clients.
Managed end-to-end SDLC execution including planning, integration, risk mitigation, and stakeholder governance.
Strengthened service delivery frameworks and SLA adherence across managed service portfolios.

education.degree: Post Graduate Diploma in Computer Applications (PGDCA)

certifications.name: ITIL Foundation Certificate in IT Service Management, Certification
PMI Member and North India PMI Chapter Member
